status: Cumulative child and producer-export budgets are mandatory after any explicit reconciliation; other review screens retain their optional policy

blocking_checks.cumulative_child_output: Sum all children of each parent in each selected region; must not exceed baseline X
blocking_checks.cumulative_child_trade: Sum all children of each parent on each directed foreign route; must not exceed baseline parent Z + Y deliveries
blocking_checks.producer_exports: Sum foreign exports of each child in each selected producing region; must not exceed that child's output
blocking_checks.automatic_adjustment: None in acceptance checks; explicit cleaning-policy.json reconciliation creates separate audited priors before acceptance
blocking_checks.incomplete_output_coverage: stop; never infer missing observations as zero

output_vs_observed_exports.interpretation: Initial review threshold only. Check valuation, scope and re-exports before interpreting as an error.

reconciliation.accounting_identities: Enforce within declared solver numerical tolerances and report post-solve residuals.
reconciliation.observed_target_bands: Configurable by source and observation; the warning threshold is not an assumed statistical uncertainty.

baseline_policy.diagnostics: Record existing accounting residuals separately from changes introduced by disaggregation.
baseline_policy.solver_incompatibility: Report an incompatibility with the selected constraints; never repair baseline matrices to obtain a pass.
